content:
We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the carbonyl-ene reaction retrosynthetically (i.e., break the new C-C bond and C-O bond to get precursor with alkene and carbonyl). The task: return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule, reproduces the reaction. So we need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: "C-C double bonds" (alkene broken) and "ketones" (carbonyl broken). functional_groups_formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls" and "five-membered rings". Also bond order changed: C=C to C-C (order change) and C=O to C-O (order change). So we can search with criteria.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate parameters.
